title: A batch judge call whose reply matches no item is retried once, and an empty verdict list is refused
goal: factdiff's batch judge retries once a call whose reply matched no item; JUDGE_SCHEMA refuses an empty verdicts list

run:
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import factdiff as f
items = [{'fact': 'The setting is on by default. [DOC S1]', 'old': 'The setting is on by default.', 'new': 'The setting is on by default.'}]
seen = []
def call(prompt, model, cap):
    seen.append(1)
    v = [] if len(seen) == 1 else [{'n': 1, 'verdict': 'supported', 'sentence': 'The setting is on by default.'}]
    return {'verdicts': v, 'cost_usd': 0.0, 'usage': {}, 'error': ''}
verdicts, calls = f.judge_items(items, size=5, jobs=1, cap_usd=0.1, call=call)
print('calls made', len(seen), 'verdicts', verdicts)
sys.exit(0 if len(seen) == 2 and verdicts.get(0, {}).get('verdict') == 'supported' else 1)

import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import factdiff as f
n=f.JUDGE_SCHEMA['properties']['verdicts'].get('minItems',0);print(n);sys.exit(0 if n>=1 else 1)
